#!/usr/bin/python3
"""Measure only the existing admission curl, without reading bearer stdin.

No new requests. Preserve stdout/body/status, TLS, proxy, timeout and request
arguments. Append only fixed non-secret curl timing fields and the run id.
"""
import json
import os
import re
import sys

REAL_CURL = "/usr/bin/curl"
METRICS = "<scratch>/hosted-charge-trace-20261013.tsv"
args = sys.argv[1:]
run_id = None
try:
    url = next(arg for arg in args if arg.startswith(("https://", "http://127.0.0.1:")) and arg.endswith("/build/runs"))
    method = args[args.index("-X") + 1]
    body = json.loads(args[args.index("--data-binary") + 1])
    if not isinstance(body, dict):
        raise ValueError("not an admission object")
    candidate = body.get("run_id")
    if method == "POST" and isinstance(candidate, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}", candidate):
        run_id = candidate
except (StopIteration, ValueError, IndexError, json.JSONDecodeError):
    pass
if run_id is not None:
    fields = [run_id, "%{time_namelookup}", "%{time_connect}", "%{time_appconnect}",
              "%{time_pretransfer}", "%{time_starttransfer}", "%{time_total}",
              "%{http_version}", "%{proxy_used}", "%{remote_ip}", "%header{cf-ray}", "%{http_code}"]
    # The original client splits the last stdout line as HTTP status. Switch
    # back to stdout only for that same status suffix, never for the metrics.
    fmt = "%output{>>" + METRICS + "}" + "\t".join(fields) + "\n%{stdout}\n%{http_code}"
    args += ["--write-out", fmt]
os.execv(REAL_CURL, [REAL_CURL, *args])
